focus: possessive article mein- before a feminine noun
possessive article dein- before a masculine noun (nominative)
possessive article for the polite Sie, plural noun
trap: Polite "Ihr/Ihre" is written with a capital letter.

focus: possessive article unser- before a plural noun
possessive article in the accusative, masculine noun
trap: Only the masculine changes in the accusative: mein -> meinen, sein -> seinen.

model: Finde den Fehler: Ich brauche meine Pass.
focus: find the mistake: accusative ending of a masculine noun
trap: der Pass is masculine: accusative = meinen.

model: Sag auf Deutsch: This is our car.
focus: possessive article unser before a neuter noun, translation
trap: unser: no ending before a neuter noun in the nominative (like ein).

model: Du duzt deine Nachbarin. Frage sie, ob der Schlüssel ihr gehört.
focus: ask about ownership with a possessive article
